Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The meta Whirlwind build, retuned for Tower and high Pit tiers rather than general farming. Two facts from the knowledge base drive every change: Maxroll's week-1 review reports that Rend and Flame Charge - not Whirlwind - are the Barbarian builds dominating Tower leaderboards, and Maxroll's push list puts five Barbarian builds in S tier while its overall endgame list puts three. So the same class carries you either way, but the tuning differs. This variant keeps the Whirlwind engine (which you have already geared) and shifts affixes, defensive slots and the Mythic choice toward surviving and sustaining at push tiers, where a single mistake ends the run. Take this only after barbarian-meta-whirlwind is fully geared - it is a retune, not a fresh character.

Rotation
  1. Pull wide, land War Cry for Vulnerable, pop Wrath of the Berserker and spin through the +30% window with Whirlwind.
  2. Keep Challenging Shout and Rallying Cry on cooldown, and drop Iron Skin before the dangerous elite lands its telegraph rather than after.
Variants

Leveling — Ground Stomp, shouts, spin. Lunging Strike when Fury is empty. Life affixes are fine at this stage - you have no Melted Heart of Selig yet.
Move on when Level 70 and Pit Tier 10 cleared for Torment 1.

Early Endgame — Spin continuously, shouts and Wrath of the Berserker on cooldown, Iron Skin proactively before you take a hit rather than reactively after. No Lunging Strike safety net, so keep Rallying Cry honest for resource.
Move on when Gohr's Devastating Grips equipped and you are farming Superior Lair Keys for the Corrupted Reaper - that is when the Mythic decision arrives.

Late Endgame — Unchanged loop, but audit your gear for stray Life affixes every time you swap a piece - one forgotten Life roll silently shrinks Melted Heart of Selig. Mercenary: Raheir hired for the cheat-death, Aldkin's Field of Languish as reinforcement.
Move on when Melted Heart of Selig equipped with a clean no-Life gear set, glyphs levelled evenly - go push.

Pushing — Pull wide, War Cry for Vulnerable, Wrath of the Berserker, spin through the +30% window, Iron Skin before the dangerous elite lands its telegraph. If you stall two Tower tiers below your Pit ceiling, respec to Rend rather than regearing - Rend is what is actually topping Tower leaderboards this season.

No public permalink for a Whirlwind-specific Barbarian filter was exposed via automated fetch, so this links the site's real class/build Finder — search class Barbarian, build Whirlwind, and prefer the strict/push strictness tier for Tower and high-Pit pushing rather than the general endgame code.

Uniques
  • gloves Target-farm Grigoire, the Galvanic Saint — an Initiate-tier Lair boss (costs 1 Lair Key) — for this Barbarian glove unique. Backup: Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe (Common gloves + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust) rerolls a random gloves-slot unique. Where →
  • helm Target-farm Bartuc, the alternate final boss inside Infernal Hordes — skip the Fel Council and spend 666 Burning Aether to open his chamber instead; he is the dedicated drop source for this Barbarian helm. Where →
  • pants No dedicated boss this season — Season 14 moved it off boss loot tables. Farm it via the Horadric Cube: Common pants + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust rerolls into a random pants-slot unique; save duplicates for the 3-identical-uniques 'Recycle' recipe to push toward better affixes. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique — any boss has a small chance to drop it directly, and Corrupted Reaper in the Pandemonium Threshold has the best Mythic drop rate in the game. To guarantee it, craft via the Horadric Cube with 4 Pandemonium Fragments (farmed from Corrupted Reaper) or via the Jeweler with Runes + Resplendent Sparks — only one crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. Where →
  • weapon Mythic Unique — any boss can drop it at a rare rate (Corrupted Reaper has the best odds), or craft it via the Horadric Cube (4 Pandemonium Fragments) or the Jeweler. This build slots dropped copies rather than crafting, since Melted Heart of Selig already occupies the single crafted-Mythic slot. Where →
  • weapon Target-farm The Butcher at Greater Lair tier (costs 1 Greater Lair Key) — he is the dedicated Barbarian source for this weapon; alternative dropped-Mythic slot alongside or instead of The Grandfather. Where →
  • ring Mythic Unique with no dedicated boss: every Lair boss can drop it, or craft it in the Horadric Cube with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic may be equipped at a time. Where →

How to run them

Same pairing as the base build - Raheir hired with Ground Slam, Bastion, Inspiration and Raheir's Aegis, Aldkin reinforcing with Field of Languish - and on this variant the choice is less optional than it is on the base build. Tower floors kill you through incoming damage rather than through a damage check, so Raheir's Valiance cheat-death and Aldkin's area damage reduction are both doing real work. Icy Veins' Varyana/Bloodthirst reinforcement is the offensive alternative and is the wrong side of the trade here: this variant already gave up Lunging Strike for Iron Skin on the same reasoning.

Plan

Same system and the same caveat as the base build: Maxroll ships one generic default War Plans tree for every Season 14 Whirlwind profile and explicitly tells you to adapt it. The adaptation for a Tower variant is to weight The Pit and Nightmare Dungeons over the material-farming trees, because what gates a Tower push is glyph level, not gear acquisition.

What is lit7 picks recorded on 4 of 7 activities. Everything else is dimmed, not ruled out: the trees below are the game's own 100 nodes, and a War Plan is per character.
Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

The meta Whirlwind build, retuned for Tower and high Pit tiers rather than general farming. Two facts from the knowledge base drive every change: Maxroll's week-1 review reports that Rend and Flame Charge - not Whirlwind - are the Barbarian builds dominating Tower leaderboards, and Maxroll's push list puts five Barbarian builds in S tier while its overall endgame list puts three. So the same class carries you either way, but the tuning differs. This variant keeps the Whirlwind engine (which you have already geared) and shifts affixes, defensive slots and the Mythic choice toward surviving and sustaining at push tiers, where a single mistake ends the run. Take this only after barbarian-meta-whirlwind is fully geared - it is a retune, not a fresh character.

Rotation
  1. Pull wide, land War Cry for Vulnerable, pop Wrath of the Berserker and spin through the +30% window with Whirlwind.
  2. Keep Challenging Shout and Rallying Cry on cooldown, and drop Iron Skin before the dangerous elite lands its telegraph rather than after.
Variants

Leveling — Ground Stomp, shouts, spin. Lunging Strike when Fury is empty. Life affixes are fine at this stage - you have no Melted Heart of Selig yet.
Move on when Level 70 and Pit Tier 10 cleared for Torment 1.

Early Endgame — Spin continuously, shouts and Wrath of the Berserker on cooldown, Iron Skin proactively before you take a hit rather than reactively after. No Lunging Strike safety net, so keep Rallying Cry honest for resource.
Move on when Gohr's Devastating Grips equipped and you are farming Superior Lair Keys for the Corrupted Reaper - that is when the Mythic decision arrives.

Late Endgame — Unchanged loop, but audit your gear for stray Life affixes every time you swap a piece - one forgotten Life roll silently shrinks Melted Heart of Selig. Mercenary: Raheir hired for the cheat-death, Aldkin's Field of Languish as reinforcement.
Move on when Melted Heart of Selig equipped with a clean no-Life gear set, glyphs levelled evenly - go push.

Pushing — Pull wide, War Cry for Vulnerable, Wrath of the Berserker, spin through the +30% window, Iron Skin before the dangerous elite lands its telegraph. If you stall two Tower tiers below your Pit ceiling, respec to Rend rather than regearing - Rend is what is actually topping Tower leaderboards this season.

Uniques
  • gloves Target-farm Grigoire, the Galvanic Saint — an Initiate-tier Lair boss (costs 1 Lair Key) — for this Barbarian glove unique. Backup: Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe (Common gloves + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust) rerolls a random gloves-slot unique. Where →
  • helm Target-farm Bartuc, the alternate final boss inside Infernal Hordes — skip the Fel Council and spend 666 Burning Aether to open his chamber instead; he is the dedicated drop source for this Barbarian helm. Where →
  • pants No dedicated boss this season — Season 14 moved it off boss loot tables. Farm it via the Horadric Cube: Common pants + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust rerolls into a random pants-slot unique; save duplicates for the 3-identical-uniques 'Recycle' recipe to push toward better affixes. Where →
  • amulet Mythic Unique — any boss has a small chance to drop it directly, and Corrupted Reaper in the Pandemonium Threshold has the best Mythic drop rate in the game. To guarantee it, craft via the Horadric Cube with 4 Pandemonium Fragments (farmed from Corrupted Reaper) or via the Jeweler with Runes + Resplendent Sparks — only one crafted Mythic can be equipped at a time. Where →
  • weapon Mythic Unique — any boss can drop it at a rare rate (Corrupted Reaper has the best odds), or craft it via the Horadric Cube (4 Pandemonium Fragments) or the Jeweler. This build slots dropped copies rather than crafting, since Melted Heart of Selig already occupies the single crafted-Mythic slot. Where →
  • weapon Target-farm The Butcher at Greater Lair tier (costs 1 Greater Lair Key) — he is the dedicated Barbarian source for this weapon; alternative dropped-Mythic slot alongside or instead of The Grandfather. Where →
  • ring Mythic Unique with no dedicated boss: every Lair boss can drop it, or craft it in the Horadric Cube with Pandemonium Fragments - remembering that only one Cube-crafted Mythic may be equipped at a time. Where →

Reasoning

Based onWhirlwind Barbarian
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Drop Lunging Strike for Iron Skin from early_endgame onward, not just at the pushing stage. Reason: the base build keeps Lunging Strike as a Fury fallback, but 3.1.0 capped Fury generation at 0.5 Fury per 1% Maximum Life and cut it off from Resource Generation bonuses, so the fallback returns less than it used to while the survivability slot is worth strictly more at push tiers.
  2. Prioritise Cooldown Reduction over Attack Speed on gloves and amulet. Reason: Wrath of the Berserker now grants a flat +30% all damage for its duration in 3.1.x, so uptime on that one button is a bigger multiplier than incremental spin speed once your attack-speed breakpoint is already met.
  3. Keep Melted Heart of Selig as the crafted Mythic and be strict about it: zero Life affixes anywhere on gear. Reason: the Mythic doubles your resource pool and converts it into your effective life pool, so Life rolls dilute it. Season 14 allows only ONE crafted Mythic equipped at a time, so this is the whole crafted-Mythic budget - do not craft a second and expect to use both.
  4. Slot dropped Mythic weapons (The Grandfather or Ramaladni's Magnum Opus) rather than crafting them. Reason: the one-crafted-Mythic limit applies only to crafted items - dropped Mythics are unlimited, and the Corrupted Reaper in the Pandemonium Threshold has the best Mythic drop rates in the game. Since patch 3.1.2 Mythics can also be recycled, so a wrong craft is recoverable.
  5. Farm Superior Lair Keys deliberately instead of opportunistically, and run Ruptures in Helltide zones rather than in the Pit. Reason: Ruptures spawn most often in Helltide zones and their spawn frequency was explicitly decreased in the Pit, so Pit runs are for pushing, not for seasonal loot.
  6. Do not slot Aspect of Walloping and do not build into 2-Handed Techniques. Reason: Walloping is confirmed non-functional with the Whirlwind Tornado upgrade, and 2-Handed Techniques are partially or wholly broken this patch. This matters more here than in the base build because push builds have no slack for a dead multiplier.
  7. Keep a Rend respec saved. Reason: Rend is S tier on the push list and is what is actually topping Tower leaderboards; if your Whirlwind clear stalls two tiers below your Pit ceiling, the class is not the problem and swapping skills is cheaper than regearing.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.
